question: Which student activist became the first SFI member to be elected sarpanch in Gujarat in June 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Satyesha Leuva**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Satyesha Leuva**, a student activist, became the first **Student Federation of India (SFI) member** to be elected as a **sarpanch in Gujarat** in **June 2025**.
 
• The election represents a significant milestone for the **SFI**, a left-wing student organization, in a state traditionally dominated by other political affiliations.
 
• Her victory highlights the growing influence of student-led activism in rural areas and their contribution to local governance.
 
• Satyesha Leuva’s campaign focused on addressing local issues such as **education, employment opportunities, and infrastructure development**, which resonated with the voters.
 
• Her election is seen as a progressive step towards youth participation in grassroots governance in Gujarat.
